sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal: congressional trades are stale (>1 year old), market sentiment is balanced neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (187), imminent CPI event, and negative macro score (-7) create severe near-term headwinds despite 73-day earnings buffer.
